About this programme

Only the external programme is shown. A prepared UCR comparison has been withheld from presentation.

Health Sciences, Policy & Management of Healthcare at Erasmus studies health services through economics, law, social-medical science, public policy, organisations and ethics. Its Dutch-taught, full-time BSc combines thematic study with research and practical projects.

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The official sources give conflicting information about the final-year credit structure, so no complete pathway or UCR comparison is certified here.

Academic year: 2026–2027

The programme page assigns 30 EC to free choice, while the regulation’s indexed text assigns 25 EC. The full final-year allocation and applicable requirements need confirmation from the current regulation.
